The personal airport greeting - a courtesy Mr Trump was notably denied when he visited Beijing in May - begins three days of pageantry that will include another flyover and a state banquet at the White House today.

Analysts said that China had meanwhile begun to look past Mr Trump, whose second term ends in early 2029, and is in many ways playing for time and using the truce to consolidate its position.
